q: Is LPG in India propane or butane?
title: Indian LPG: propane and butane mix
short: Both. PPAC's Ready Reckoner describes LPG as about 40% propane and 60% butane. That is why Indian factories use the general LPG emission factor, about 2.98 kg CO2 per kg from IPCC, rather than a pure propane or pure butane figure.
audience: Factories, kitchens and dryers running on LPG

ul: Source: PPAC Ready Reckoner FY 2025-26, Table 9.4.

sections.h: Why it matters for your numbers
p: Propane and butane have slightly different carbon content per kilogram, so a pure-gas factor from a foreign database can be a little off for Indian LPG. Bill quantities in kilograms times the LPG factor is the standard route.

senseible: Senseible reads the quantity and unit printed on each fuel invoice, converts it with a stated density or calorific value, and shows the factor and source on every line, so a litre or kilogram is never guessed.
